arguments.command:
python -c "
import semver
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test that all module-level functions still work
print('Testing existing functionality...')
assert semver.parse('1.2.3') == {'major': 1, 'minor': 2, 'patch': 3, 'prerelease': None, 'build': None}
assert semver.compare('1.0.0', '2.0.0') == -1
assert semver.match('1.0.0', '<2.0.0') == True
assert semver.bump_major('1.2.3') == '2.0.0'
assert semver.bump_minor('1.2.3') == '1.3.0'
assert semver.bump_patch('1.2.3') == '1.2.4'
assert semver.finalize_version('1.2.3-rc.5') == '1.2.3'
assert str(semver.max_ver('1.0.0', '2.0.0')) == '2.0.0'
assert str(semver.min_ver('1.0.0', '2.0.0')) == '1.0.0'
print('All existing functionality works!')

# Test new features
print()
print('Testing new features...')

# R1: Immutability
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
try:
    v.major = 9
except AttributeError:
    print('R1 PASS: major is immutable')

# R2: Iteration
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
assert list(v) == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build']
print('R2 PASS: iteration works')

# R3: Tuple comparison
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
assert v == (1, 2, 3)
assert v < (2, 0, 0)
assert v > (0, 0, 0)
try:
    _ = v == 'string'
except TypeError:
    print('R3 PASS: string comparison disallowed')
try:
    _ = v < 5
except TypeError:
    print('R3 PASS: integer comparison disallowed')

# R4: Bump methods
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
assert str(v.bump_major()) == '2.0.0'
assert str(v.bump_minor()) == '1.3.0'
assert str(v.bump_patch()) == '1.2.4'
assert str(VersionInfo(1,2,3,'rc.1').bump_prerelease()) == '1.2.3-rc.2'
assert str(VersionInfo(1,2,3,build='1').bump_build()) == '1.2.3+2'
print('R4 PASS: bump methods work')

# R5: Type conversion
v = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 'alpha', 'build')
assert isinstance(v.major, int)
assert isinstance(v.prerelease, str)
print('R5 PASS: type conversion works')

# R6: CLI functions
assert hasattr(semver, 'createparser')
assert hasattr(semver, 'main')
assert hasattr(semver, 'process')
print('R6 PASS: CLI functions exposed')

# R7: Replace
new_ver = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
assert new_ver == '2.2.3'
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
assert str(v.replace(major=2)) == '2.2.3'
print('R7 PASS: replace works')

print()
print('ALL REQUIREMENTS VERIFIED SUCCESSFULLY!')
"
